cheapskateaitranslator.description: Create draft language versions and optionally translate their language-specific text properties with an AI or translation provider.
cheapskateaitranslator.preconfiguredHelp: Leave the masked value unchanged to keep the saved key, or enter a new key.
cheapskateaitranslator.azureRegionHelp: Required for regional or multi-service Azure Translator resources, for example westeurope. Leave empty for a global Translator resource when supported.
cheapskateaitranslator.modelHelp: Enter the model identifier supported by the selected provider. Suggestions are provided for common models.
cheapskateaitranslator.conserveApiCalls: Conserve API calls by grouping properties into bounded prompts
cheapskateaitranslator.geminiGuide: Google Gemini: create an API key in Google AI Studio, then use the prefilled Google Generative Language endpoint and enter a model supported by your account. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is suggested by default.
cheapskateaitranslator.azureGuide: Azure Translator: create a Translator resource in Azure, copy its subscription key, and use the endpoint for your resource region. Add the region to a custom endpoint when required.
cheapskateaitranslator.deeplGuide: DeepL: create an API key in the DeepL account settings. The free service uses the prefilled api-free.deepl.com endpoint.
cheapskateaitranslator.groqGuide: GroqCloud: create an API key in the Groq console. Use the prefilled endpoint and choose a model available to your account.
cheapskateaitranslator.otherGuide: Other: enter an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint, API key, and model. The endpoint must accept the standard chat-completions request format.
cheapskateaitranslator.generalGuide: Keys are stored in the CMS settings store. Keep this page restricted to trusted CMS administrators.
